description: Curated, project-safe subset of the Knowledge Vault. Contains ONLY notes that their owner has reviewed and approved for repo/agent access. Personal or private data is prohibited here.
purpose: Layer 3 (Obsidian) to Layer 0 (CocoIndex) bridge — hand-picked archival notes that agents may read for context. Not a mirror of the personal Obsidian vault.
notes: Only files matching 'allowed_patterns' may live here. Anything else fails CI.
Personal Obsidian data must never be added to this repo. When in doubt, leave it out.
